svg.title: Review: inside against outside the radius areas in FCT, Nasarawa and Adamawa, April 2025
svg.desc: Abuja: inside (arm B) $6.21, outside (arm A) $0.10; Adamawa: inside (arm A) $0.83, outside (arm B) $4.77; Nasarawa: inside (arm B) $59.54, outside (arm A) $2.63.
svg.text: FOR REVIEW, NOT FOR PUBLICATION · NIGERIA, 9–18 APR 2025
AD COST PER QUALIFIED RESPONDENT, GENDER POOLED. ARM = THE SURVEY FORM THE ADS LED TO.
Arm A is the cheaper side in all three states, whichever side of the line it was on.
Report of 18 Apr 2025. Towns from GeoNames, for orientation only.
